senses.gloss:
--(नकुलेश्वरी)--Mind-born daughter of ललिता, riding on गरुड to vanquish सर्पिनी, was attacked by the five commanders of भण्ड: नकुली cut off Karanka's head when the army retreated in fear to सून्यक city;
1: Br. IV. २३. ५२-93; २८. ३९.
an अवतार् of the Lord.
2: वा. २३. २२१.
--a R. from the lake विष्णुपद. Br. II. १८. ६८.
--a son of पृथुसेन (पृथु-ब्र्।, वि।, and वा। प्।) and father of Gaya. भा. V. १५. 6. Br. II. १४. ६८; वा. ३३. ५७; Vi. II. 1. ३८. [page२-191+ ३६]

--the author and a master of Atharva- सम्हिता;
1: भा. XII. 7. 4; वा. ६१. ५४.
a portion of Atharva Veda.
2: Br. II. ३५. ६१. Vi. III. 6. १३.
--a vow in honour of नारायण-- detailed. M. ५४. 7-३०.

--one lac of Yojanas from the moon;
1: वा. १९. २२; ५३. ९६; १०१. १३०.
the orbit of lunar constellation above the moon; above that at a distance of 2 lacs of Yojanas is Budha.
2: Vi. II. 7. 6-7.

--a son of Kali: had no body: married सकुनी;
1: Br. III. ५९. १०; वा. ८४. १०, १३.
a man-eater.
2: वा. ८४. ११.
--a measurement according to stars and their movements. Br. II. २१. १३७; वा. ५०. १८८.
